minLines.description: minimum size of code block in lines to check for duplication

maxLines.description: maximum size of source file in lines to check for duplication

maxSize.description: maximum size of source file in bytes to check for duplication (e.g., 102400, 1kb, 1m, 120kb)

minTokens.description: minimum size of code block in tokens to check for duplication

threshold.description: maximum allowed duplicate lines expressed as a percentage; exit with error and exit code 1 when threshold exceeded

formatsExts.description: custom mapping from formats to file extensions, as an object or mapping string (e.g. javascript:es,es6;dart:dt); see https://github.com/kucherenko/jscpd/blob/master/FORMATS.md

output.description: path to directory for non-console reports

path.description: paths that should be included in duplicate detection (default: [process.cwd()])

pattern.description: glob pattern for files that should be included in duplicate detection (e.g., **/*.txt); only used to filter directories configured via path option

ignorePattern.description: ignore code blocks matching these regular expressions

ignore.description: glob pattern for files that should be excluded from duplicate detection

format.description: format or list of formats for which to detect duplication (default: all); see https://github.com/kucherenko/jscpd/blob/master/FORMATS.md

store.description: store used to collect information about code. v4 supports external stores such as leveldb and redis; v5 reports this config field as migrated to the CLI --store flag.

reporters.description: a list of reporters to use to output information about duplication; built-ins include console, consoleFull/console-full, json, xml, csv, html, markdown, badge, sarif, ai, xcode, threshold, and silent; third-party reporters are also supported

blame.description: get information about authors and dates of duplicated blocks from Git

silent.description: do not write duplicate detection progress and result to console

verbose.description: show full information during duplicate detection

skipLocal.description: skip duplicates within folders; just detect cross-folder duplicates

ignoreCase.description: ignore case of symbols in code (experimental)

gitignore.description: respect .gitignore files. Enabled by default in current jscpd; set false to opt out in v4 configs.

path.description: output path for duplication level badge (default: path.join(output, 'jscpd-badge.svg'))

label.description: badge subject text (URL-encoding needed for spaces or special characters)

labelColor.description: badge label color (name or RGB code without #); see https://github.com/badgen/badgen/blob/master/src/color-presets.ts

status.description: badge value text (URL-encoding needed for spaces or special characters, default: duplication %)

color.description: badge color (name or RGB code without #, default: green if beneath threshold, red if above threshold, grey if threshold not set); see https://github.com/badgen/badgen/blob/master/src/color-presets.ts

icon.description: URL for icon to display in front of badge subject text (e.g., data:image/svg+xml;base64,...)

iconWidth.description: SVG width of icon to display in front of badge subject text; set this if icon is not square

scale.description: size of badge relative to default of 1

exitCode.description: exit code to use when at least one duplicate code block is detected but threshold is not exceeded

formatsNames.description: custom mapping from formats to exact filenames without relying on extensions (e.g. makefile:Makefile,GNUmakefile); see https://github.com/kucherenko/jscpd/blob/master/FORMATS.md

formats.description: v5 alias for format; format or list of formats for which to detect duplication

storePath.description: directory used by the v4 store for cache files, useful for isolating parallel LevelDB runs. v5 reports this config field as migrated to the CLI --store-path flag.

noGitignore.description: v5 config field matching --no-gitignore; do not respect .gitignore files

followSymlinks.description: v5 config field matching --follow-symlinks; follow symbolic links

noSymLinks.description: compatibility alias for noSymlinks with a capital L; prefer noSymlinks or followSymlinks

noTips.description: suppress tips and promotional messages after detection

debug.description: show debug information and do not run detection in v4; silently ignored by v5 config compatibility handling

crossFormats.description: detect clones across formats: semicolon-separated groups of comma-separated formats (e.g. javascript,typescript;css,scss), or the groups as an array; the preset js-ts stands for javascript,jsx,typescript,tsx

sarifErrorTokens.description: report SARIF results as error for clones with at least this many tokens; smaller clones stay warning

skipIsolated.description: skip clones between different folders of the same isolation group, e.g. [["packages/a", "packages/b"]]

baseline.description: clone baseline file (e.g. .jscpd-baseline.json): clones whose fingerprint is absent from it are reported as new; see https://github.com/kucherenko/jscpd/blob/master/docs/rust.md#baseline

baselineFromRef.description: compare against an ephemeral baseline built from a git ref's tree (e.g. origin/main): clones absent from it are reported as new

failOnNewClones.description: exit with code 1 when more than this many new clones are found; needs baseline, baselineFromRef or --changed

ignoreIdentifiers.description: treat identifiers as equal, so clones that differ only in variable, function or type names are found; true or consistent matches only where every name stands for one name on the other side, blind lets any name match any other

ignoreLiterals.description: treat all string literals as equal and all numeric literals as equal

ignoreAnnotations.description: skip annotations and decorators (@Name, @Name(...)) before detection

maxGapLines.description: merge clones of one file pair separated by at most this many unmatched lines in both files into one near-miss clone, reported as similar; 0 disables

similarity.description: report pairs of functions whose normalized syntax trees have at least this share of subtrees in common as similar clones

failOnEmpty.description: exit with code 1 when the scan analyzes no files

history.description: git revision range scanned by --history for the duplication and health trend (e.g. v5.0.0..HEAD); see https://github.com/kucherenko/jscpd/blob/master/docs/rust.md#history

historySince.description: select the commits of --history since this date (e.g. 2026-01-01)

historyEvery.description: keep every Nth commit of the --history series, counted from the newest

historyLimit.description: maximum number of commits in the --history series

deadCode.description: dead-code settings; true is the short form of {"enabled": true}, which runs dead-code detection instead of clone detection; see https://github.com/kucherenko/jscpd/blob/master/docs/rust.md#in-the-config-file

basta.description: alias for deadCode. dead-code settings; true is the short form of {"enabled": true}, which runs dead-code detection instead of clone detection; see https://github.com/kucherenko/jscpd/blob/master/docs/rust.md#in-the-config-file

entry.description: treat files matching these globs as dead-code entry points

health.description: tuning of the health score: halfLife and weight of duplication, deadCode and complexity, complexFile, and metrics from other tools; see https://github.com/kucherenko/jscpd/blob/master/docs/rust.md#health-score

healthInput.description: JSON file with metrics from other tools (coverage, tests, security) to include in the health score

includeTests.description: report dead code inside test, fixture and example files

includeEntryExports.description: report exports of entry-point files, which are usually a public API

kind.description: report only clones of these kinds (default: all); see https://github.com/kucherenko/jscpd/blob/master/docs/rust.md#filtering-by-kind-with---kind

minConfidence.description: drop dead-code findings below this confidence

semantic.description: find semantic clones (experimental) with a code embedding model: true, or an object of semantic-clone settings; see https://github.com/kucherenko/jscpd/blob/master/docs/rust.md#semantic-clones-with---semantic-experimental

lsp.description: the analyses --lsp runs in this project: clones, ast, semantic, deadCode and complexity; see https://github.com/kucherenko/jscpd/blob/master/docs/rust.md#editors-with---lsp

minNodes.description: the fewest nodes a function's normalized syntax tree needs for similarity to compare it

reportName.description: base name of the report files, without the extension

boundaries.description: rules that keep the code of a module, a folder, a file or a method out of other places; see https://github.com/kucherenko/jscpd/blob/master/docs/rust.md#boundaries

summary.description: print a codebase summary: top files and folders by tokens, lines, size and complexity

summaryTop.description: number of entries in each summary top list
